subject: planner: don't choose merge join unless there's hint or join key fully matched (#59933)
summary: Reviewed `GetMergeJoin` changes in `pkg/planner/core/exhaust_physical_plans.go:166`: merge join is no longer enumerated when join keys are only partially matched by child possible orderings (now requires full join-key match on both sides; cartesian joins skipped), while the enforced merge-join path (`getEnforcedMergeJoin`) remains for `MERGE_JOIN` hint / `NO_HASH_JOIN` fallback. No Blocker/High correctness, SQL semantics, or transaction/session behavioral issues found; impact is planner plan-choice/performance only.
